prompt:
Recreate the Saigon Traffic Camera app screen A: 'Camera — Grid'. Mobile viewport 390x844.

Art Direction: Authentic Cupertino Apple-like LIQUID GLASS.
- Warm near-white background (#f8fafc) with subtle cool cyan/teal illumination.
- Compact Header:
  - Top line: 'Camera TP.HCM' with small camera glyph and tiny subtle glass badge 'Dữ liệu mẫu'.
  - Search & Location row: Translucent glass search bar capsule (placeholder 'Tìm tên đường hoặc camera', glass search icon) with an integrated or adjacent cyan-tinted Liquid Glass location pill: map pin icon, 'Tân Mỹ', and chevron down icon (min-h-[48px]).
  - Mode Switcher: Liquid glass segmented control with 3 segments: 'Card', 'Grid' (ACTIVE, highlighted with crisp translucent white pill), 'List'. To the right, a compact 3-column density button (grid icon).
- Content Area (scrollable 2-column photo grid):
  - Section '★ Quan tâm' (or 'Yêu thích'):
    - Camera 1: 'Huỳnh Tấn Phát - Phú Thuận', subtitle 'Phường Phú Thuận • TTH 320'. Photo shows Saigon street traffic (scooters, road, daylight). Top right: translucent glass circle with FILLED yellow star icon.
    - Camera 2: 'Nguyễn Thị Thập - Tân Mỹ', subtitle 'Phường Tân Mỹ • TTH 322'. Photo showing street with shops and motorbikes. Top right: FILLED yellow star.
    - Camera 3: 'Huỳnh Tấn Phát - Nguyễn Thị Thập', subtitle 'Phường Tân Thuận • TTH 246'. Photo showing bus and traffic. Top right: FILLED yellow star.
    - Camera 4: 'Nguyễn Thị Thập - Lê Văn Lương', subtitle 'Phường Tân Hưng • TTH 327'. Photo with yellow truck and bikes. Top right: FILLED yellow star.
    - Camera 5 (Error State Tile): Instead of offline, an opaque neutral light gray card with a camera-off/alert icon, clear title 'Nguyễn Hữu Thọ - Nguyễn Thị Thập', subtitle 'Phường Tân Hưng • TTH 25.1', text 'Không tải được ảnh' and a small retry button 'Thử lại' with reload icon. Translucent glass star button on top right.
    - Camera 6: 'Nguyễn Văn Linh - Nguyễn Thị Thập', subtitle 'Phường Tân Mỹ • TTH 324.1'. Photo showing busy wide intersection. Top right: FILLED yellow star.
  - Section 'Khu vực Tân Mỹ' (or remaining cameras):
    - 2 more cards with unsaved outline star (star_border, dark gray/white stroke).
  - Infinite scroll indicator at bottom: subtle compact spinner + 'Đang tải thêm... • Đã tải 6 camera (Dữ liệu mẫu)'.
- Bottom Navigation Dock:
  - Floating Liquid Glass capsule fixed above bottom safe area:
  - Exactly TWO destinations: 'Camera' (active: filled teal videocam icon + 'Camera' label on one line, active glass pill) and 'Quan tâm' (inactive: outline favorite heart + 'Quan tâm' label).
  - Authentic Liquid Glass: backdrop-blur-2xl, translucent white bg with cool cyan reflection, thin specular white highlight border, soft shadow. Content visibly blurs behind it.
- All interactive touch targets are at least 48px. Typography in Be Vietnam Pro / SF Pro with crisp Vietnamese diacritics. Clean, professional, premium native iOS utility.
title: Camera — Grid (Cupertino Liquid Glass)
